package.name: ros2_rtt_msgs
package.description: Fixed-size POD message types for ros2_rtt_bench. One Pod<N>.msg per payload size in the round-trip sweep. POD layout (uint64 ts_ns + uint8[N-8] payload) is what CycloneDDS+iceoryx and FastDDS+SHM require to satisfy `Publisher::can_loan_messages() == true`, which is the zero-copy publisher path the benchmark exercises.
